rules.name: AWS Access Key
rules.description: Detects AWS access keys (AKIA...)

rules.name: AWS Secret Key
rules.description: Detect 40-character AWS secret values only with a secret-key assignment label; arbitrary hashes and URL path components are not AWS credentials.

rules.name: GitHub Token
rules.description: Detects GitHub personal access tokens

rules.name: Slack Token
rules.description: Detect xox-prefixed Slack tokens and rotating xoxe refresh-token formats.

rules.name: API Key (Generic)
rules.description: Detect labelled API keys, client/shared secrets and access/auth tokens in assignments, JSON and query strings. Require an explicit credential field and at least 16 value characters.

rules.name: Bearer Token
rules.description: Detect Bearer credentials with the token alphabet including base64 padding; the minimum length remains 24.

rules.name: Private Key Header
rules.description: Detect PEM PKCS#8, encrypted PKCS#8, algorithm-specific/OpenSSH private keys and PGP private key blocks. Public keys and certificates do not match.

rules.name: High Entropy Hex Token
rules.description: Detects secret, token, or password labels followed by 32 to 64 hexadecimal characters. This is a format and length heuristic, not a measured entropy score. Quoted JSON keys and values are supported.

rules.name: Explicit password assignment
rules.description: Detect literal password assignments including common camel-case fields, YAML/JSON/env and := assignments. Exclude explicit UI-label identifiers, unquoted property references, callbacks, types, shell expansions and complete placeholders per candidate. rules.name: Credentials in connection URLs

rules.name: HTTP Basic credentials
rules.description: Detect a base64 credential following an explicit Authorization: Basic header.

rules.name: JSON Web Token
rules.description: Detect a signed JWT-shaped value with a JSON header, payload and signature; no token is authenticated or sent to an issuer.

rules.name: Labelled hexadecimal key
rules.description: Detect labelled symmetric/encryption hex keys. Public-key and sealing-public-key identifiers are not generic key fields; their presence never exempts a separate secret.

rules.name: Private JSON Web Key
rules.description: Detect asymmetric JWK private member d together with kty in the same object or object fragment, in either order. A public-only JWK does not match.

rules.name: SQL password literal
rules.description: Detect SQL IDENTIFIED BY, IDENTIFIED WITH/VIA plugin BY/AS, and PostgreSQL PASSWORD literals. No query execution or model calls; variable references and placeholders are excluded.

rules.name: Command-line password literal
rules.description: Detect explicit --password/-Password arguments, OpenSSL pass: sources and attached MySQL -p literals. Environment/file sources, interactive flags and shell variables do not match; other commands do not interpret generic -p as a password.

rules.name: NATS NKEY secret seed
rules.description: Detect 58-character, uppercase Base32 NATS NKEY seed shapes (SA/SC/SN/SO/SU/SX). Public NKEYs do not match. Exposure detection validates format, not CRC or whether a credential is active.

rules.name: Base64-encoded PEM private key
rules.description: Detect one layer of Base64-encoded PEM private-key headers with a bounded body and line wrapping. Public-key/certificate headers do not match. This is exposure detection, not cryptographic key validation or recursive decoding.

rules.name: Verification-code theft request
rules.description: Rejects selected explicit requests to steal, trick, or collect a customer's verification code, dynamic password, payment password, or card PIN. It is not transaction-fraud monitoring.
rules.expression: (?i)(?:骗取|套取|窃取|盗取|收集).{0,10}(?:客户|用户)?.{0,4}(?:短信)?(?:验证码|动态口令|支付密码|银行卡密码)|\b(?:steal|harvest|trick\s+(?:a\s+)?customer\s+into\s+sharing)\b.{0,32}\b(?:OTP|one-time password|verification code|card PIN)\b

rules.name: Assistant solicitation of sensitive credentials
rules.description: Rejects selected response phrases directing a customer to send a verification code, dynamic password, payment password, or card PIN. It cannot determine whether an authenticated channel or approved workflow applies.
rules.expression: (?i)(?!(?:请勿|请不要|不要|无需|不需要))(?:请|需要|务必).{0,8}(?:提供|告知|发送|回复).{0,12}(?:短信验证码|验证码|动态口令|支付密码|银行卡密码)|\b(?:please|you need to|you must)\s+(?:send|share|provide|reply with)\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:OTP|one-time password|verification code|card PIN)\b

rules.name: Bank identity-check evasion
rules.description: Rejects selected explicit Chinese or English requests to bypass bank identity verification, customer due diligence, or anti-money-laundering checks. It does not perform KYC or AML decisions.
rules.expression: (?i)(?:帮我|教我|如何|怎么).{0,6}(?:绕过|规避|跳过).{0,6}(?:银行)?(?:身份验证|实名认证|客户尽职调查|反洗钱检查)|\b(?:help me|show me how to)\s+(?:bypass|evade)\s+(?:bank\s+)?(?:KYC|AML|identity verification)\b

rules.name: Assistant investment-return guarantee

rules.expression: (?:本产品|该产品|我们|我行)(?![^，。！？]{0,6}(?:无法|不能|不会|不|未)).{0,6}(?:保证|承诺).{0,10}(?:保本|收益|回报|盈利)|(?:本产品|该产品).{0,6}稳赚不赔|(?i:\b(?:this product|our bank|we)\s+guarantees?\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:principal|profit|returns?)\b)
